gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: A writer built via the Builder (with an output stream supplied) reports the builder's default encoding of UTF-8.
ADDED i3: Flushing after the writer has been closed propagates the IOException raised by the now-closed underlying stream.
ADDED i4: Flushing before any output has been written is a no-op (no underlying writer exists yet), so the default encoding remains UTF-8.
ADDED i5: Completing the XML prolog ("<?xml ... ?>") triggers encoding detection, which creates an OutputStreamWriter around the null output stream; the subsequent
ADDED i7: Writing a single character that does not complete an XML prolog is buffered for encoding detection only; the default encoding stays UTF-8.
ADDED i8: Writing non-prolog text to a file-backed writer buffers it for encoding detection without selecting an encoding, so the default stays UTF-8.
ADDED i9: A freshly constructed file-backed writer reports UTF-8 as its default encoding.
ADDED i10: After starting a prolog, appending a CharSequence that completes encoding detection creates an OutputStreamWriter around the null stream; the append then fails
ADDED i12: Calling getEncoding() before any encoding has been detected dereferences the still-null charset, throwing a NullPointerException from XmlStreamWriter.
ADDED i14: Closing the writer with no prior output forces the default charset to be selected, so getEncoding() then reports UTF-8; a second close is harmless.
